name: Kreativ Report Broken Link
description: Let visitors flag broken links and manage their reports in WordPress.
cardUse: Collect visitor reports, track fixes, and export a CSV.
metaDescription: Let visitors report broken links, manage reports in WordPress, and export a CSV. This plugin does not automatically scan your site.

detailItems.title: Visitor reports, without crawling
detailItems.body: Adds a report button to enabled post types. Visitors flag the page and can optionally submit the specific broken URL when that setting is enabled. The plugin does not crawl or automatically check links.

detailItems.title: A dashboard for follow-up
detailItems.body: Filter internal and external link reports, resolve, ignore or reopen them, and export a CSV. Optional email notifications, IP masking and report retention help manage the workflow.

items.title: Pair feedback with your maintenance routine
items.body: Visitor reports tell you where someone noticed a problem. They do not prove every link is healthy. Use a separate crawler if you need automatic URL checks.

changelog.label: Status refresh
changelog.body: Plugin page copy and public metadata were refreshed to align with the current Kreativ WP release and maintenance messaging.

changelog.label: Release note link added
changelog.body: The plugin page now links directly to a dedicated update post instead of sending visitors to the generic news index.

quickStart: Install Kreativ Report Broken Link from Plugins → Add New Plugin, or upload the ZIP, then activate it.
Open Broken Links → Settings to choose post types and notifications. Optionally enable the broken link URL field; it is disabled by default.
Open a published post as a visitor and submit a report. The plugin does not scan URLs automatically.
Open Broken Links → Reports, inspect the page or reported URL, repair the link, and resolve the report. Export CSV when needed.
